title: Vrbo Reservation Total Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vrbo:reservation total_usd=*
| stats sum(total_usd) as total_value, avg(total_usd) as avg_value by property_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks property values by total and average total amount across Vrbo reservation events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `total_usd` values for each Vrbo reservation event and review total and average total amount by property.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total total amount.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which property shows the biggest total amount numbers in your Vrbo reservation data.
